checks.title: The persistence requirements are pinned in the baseline

permittedForReview.subject: AR-035-O5
permittedForReview.detail: Rehearsal 5 found and fixed the first three during the run (review findings F-1, F-2, R2-F1); its fourth, device-local durable state shared by several tabs (R2-F2), is superseded by ADR-R7-001 after Rehearsal 6's R6-D-002.

permittedForReview.subject: REHEARSAL-AGENT-INTERFACE-FREEZE§preamble-O17
permittedForReview.detail: Unsaved changes live only in the tab's memory; there is no local-durable status.

permittedForReview.subject: REHEARSAL-AGENT-INTERFACE-FREEZE§boundary-d-persistence-O2
permittedForReview.detail: Unsaved changes live only in the tab's memory; there is no local-durable status.

permittedForReview.subject: PERSIST-001-O2
permittedForReview.detail: For Causa it takes precedence over, and supersedes, any persistence, offline, local-durability, synchronization-queue or cross-tab statement in the documents ranked (4) to (7) by ADRP-001, and over the long-term platform documents listed in [docs/rehearsal-007/DEFECT-TRACEABILITY.md](rehearsal-007/DEFECT-TRACEABILITY.md).

permittedForReview.subject: PERSIST-018-O3
permittedForReview.detail: There is no offline synchronization queue: after the connection returns, the application MUST NOT replay or send saves automatically, and the changes are saved only by a new save request.

permittedForReview.subject: PERSIST-020-O2
permittedForReview.detail: The application provides no local crash recovery of investigation content, and MUST NOT imply that it does.

permittedForReview.subject: PERSIST-032-O2
permittedForReview.detail: The interface MUST NOT say that a change is saved locally, saved on this device, queued, or will be saved later.

permittedForReview.subject: EXT-DATA-004-O1
permittedForReview.detail: Credentials MUST never be committed, bundled, logged, embedded in URLs, exposed in error text, stored in localStorage, or written into domain event files.

permittedForReview.subject: D-204-O2
permittedForReview.detail: Investigation documents and unsaved changes are never written to a browser store (PERSIST-003); GitHub is the only durable store (PERSIST-005).

permittedForReview.subject: PERSIST-003-O1
permittedForReview.detail: Investigation documents, events, snapshots, manifests, unsaved changes, pending commands, save state, branch heads and write markers MUST NOT be written to localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB, Cache Storage, the Origin Private File System, cookies, a service worker, a shared worker or a BroadcastChannel.

permittedForReview.subject: PERSIST-003-O5
permittedForReview.detail: Acceptance: PAT-01 inspects every browser store after edits and saves and verifies that none holds investigation content, and PAT-13 verifies that the production artifact contains no call that writes investigation content to a browser store.

permittedForReview.subject: PERSIST-040-O3
permittedForReview.detail: The test MUST verify that neither tab shows the other's change, that each tab's indicator is Unsaved, and that every browser store holds no investigation content.

permittedForReview.subject: PERSIST-052-O2
permittedForReview.detail: The check MUST verify that the artifact contains no Web Locks call and no write of investigation content to a browser store.

permittedForReview.subject: PERSIST-004-O1
permittedForReview.detail: Correctness MUST NOT depend on cross-tab locking or messaging.

permittedForReview.subject: PERSIST-004-O2
permittedForReview.detail: The application MUST NOT use `navigator.locks` (Web Locks), a storage lease or a cross-tab message channel to coordinate investigation writes.

permittedForReview.subject: PERSIST-004-O4
permittedForReview.detail: Acceptance: PAT-11 verifies that every persistence test passes with `navigator.locks` removed from the page, and PAT-13 verifies that the production artifact references no Web Locks API.

permittedForReview.subject: PERSIST-050-O1
permittedForReview.detail: The Rehearsal 7 agent MUST run PAT-01, PAT-02, PAT-04 and PAT-05 a second time with `navigator.locks` deleted from the page before the application starts.

permittedForReview.subject: PERSIST-050-O2
permittedForReview.detail: The test MUST verify identical outcomes, and that the application never calls a Web Locks API in either run.

permittedForReview.subject: PERSIST-052-O2
permittedForReview.detail: The check MUST verify that the artifact contains no Web Locks call and no write of investigation content to a browser store.

checks.title: GitHub conflict handling is fully specified
Every new requirement has an independently verifiable acceptance obligation
No requirement instructs the agent to copy Causa implementation code

permittedForReview.subject: PERSIST-026-O2
permittedForReview.detail: It MUST NOT copy, vendor, translate or adapt application source code, tests or scripts from Causa or any earlier rehearsal repository (indy-init-rehearsal-001 to indy-init-rehearsal-006).

permittedForReview.subject: docs/VERIFICATION-PLAN-CONTRACT.md:47
